checked_obligation: Verify that equal-entry legal lists are valid candidate constructions whose subset sums are widely spaced.
reason: For a list consisting of copies of an integer k with 1 ≤ k ≤ 25, every subset sum is a multiple of k, so attainable sums are spaced by k. Taking at least ceil(200/k) copies makes the list legal. Thus the text correctly proposes such lists as candidates, without yet proving they are globally worst-case.
